profile.name: INHECO培养振荡单元
profile.description: 一种用于微孔板等实验耗材的培养振荡模块，集成加热控温、平面振荡以及抽屉式装载机构，可作为堆叠系统中的单个单元使用，常用于样品孵育、混匀和温控处理。
profile.description_en: A microplate incubator-shaker module with heating, temperature control, planar shaking, and a drawer-based loading mechanism. It is used as an individual unit in a stacked system for sample incubation, mixing, and temperature-controlled processing.
